issues.quote: He came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by my watch. He said he wanted a word, and then he sat down and we sat together there until the temple struck eleven.
issues.fact: F6: Bastien Girard (not the uncle) came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch and sat with him until eleven.
issues.misreading: The name is never given in this answer. The question was 'Did anyone come to the library?', and the nearest male referent is the uncle, who was just discussed as the one who 'dropped something heavy' upstairs. A solver could read 'He' as the uncle, which would put the uncle in the library at 10:32, after the thump and the repeater, and change the timeline.
